12. A constable or other police officer, the Director, a local director may apprehend without warrant and take to a place of safety any apparently neglected child and retain the child there until the child can be brought before a judge, or may apply to a judge for an order requiring the person in whose care the child is to produce the child before a judge at the time and place named in the order, 1934, c. 5, § 12.
